votes.motion: Commissioner DeLaina Tonks motioned to have Commissioner Lisa Fowler Chair the July 22, 2021, Planning Commission Meeting

Commissioner Nixon motioned to approve the Conditional Use Permit as requested by Heather Beck, representing K9 Lifeline. Application USE-100-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated July 9, 2021 with a possible amendment that when the location of the dumpster is solidified that it be enclosed in a solid barrier enclosure

Commissioner Ogden motioned to conditionally approve the site plan, based on the findings and subject to the specific and general conditions listed in the staff report dated July 15, 2021, as requested by Cara Hicks, representing Triago Ventures for TriView Apartments Phase 2, Site Plan Application SPR-022-2021. Site Plan approval shall become effective upon written notice from the Zoning Administrator that the specific conditions of approval have been met. The Zoning Administrator shall have the authority to determine if the specific conditions of the approval have been met and issue final no

Commissioner Tonks motioned to approve the site development standard modification from front setback as requested by Wes Baker, representing Babcock Design, Green Shoot Holdings LLC, and Scalar LLC for the Scalar Office Expansion, application SPR-0016-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated July 7, 2021

Commissioner Bingham motioned to approve the architectural development standard modification for entry doors as requested by Wes Baker, representing Babcock Design, Green Shoot Holdings LLC, and Scalar LLC for the Scalar Office Expansion, application SPR-0016-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated July 7, 2021

Commissioner Ogden motioned to approve the architectural development standard modification for transparency as requested by Wes Baker, representing Babcock Design, Green Shoot Holdings LLC, and Scalar LLC for the Scalar Office Expansion, application SPR-0016-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated July 7, 2021

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to approve the parking deviation as requested by Wes Baker, representing Babcock Design, Green Shoot Holdings LLC, and Scalar LLC for the Scalar Office Expansion, application SPR-0016-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated July 7, 2021, with the modification that the number of on-site employees be limited to no more than 65 in accordance with the parking study at any given time

Commissioner Nixon motioned to approve the Site Plan Amendment as requested by Wes Baker, representing Babcock Design, Green Shoot Holdings LLC, and Scalar LLC for the Scalar Office Expansion, application SPR-0016-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated July 7, 2021

Commissioner Tonks motioned to approve the deviation for parking diamonds as requested by Dan Gould, representing Lone Peak Parkway LLC, Application SPR-053-2021 based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated July 13, 2021

Commissioner Bingham motioned to approve the Site Plan Request as requested by Dan Gould, representing Lone Peak Parkway LLC, Application SPR-053-2021 based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated July 13, 2021

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to approve the Plat Amendment as requested by Dan Gould, representing Lone Peak Parkway LLC, Application SUBD-093-2021 based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated July 13, 2021
Commissioner Tonks motioned to adjourn the meeting. 11 Approved minutes
